o.en: Ignore the version number when the entries are marked as UNRELEASED (since dpkg 1.21.0). This is useful when you have diverging development for versions that have not yet been released.

Drop the part after the last tilde in the version number when doing version comparison to identify if two entries are supposed to be the same or not. This is useful when you keep using the same changelog entry but you increase its version number regularly. For instance, you might have 2.3-1~exp1, 2.3-1~exp2, ...
Show the usage message and exit.
